forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
In week 19 of May, teams completed 3 visits and 1 clearance. There were 4 survey teams and 4 clearance teams active; 36 team-days were worked, with 4 lost to rain or wind. To date, 14 zones have been surveyed, 2 declared free, 8 areas released and 4 cleared.

The officer’s attention: 7 zones are closed according to the access feed. No teams were stood down or without a report for more than a week. No dossiers or reports were held or queried. A new plan, P05, was approved this week.

The forecast for the zones of the plan it was made with, counting what is done already, is 10 to 13 mine areas cleared and 10 to 14 zones declared free this season, at P10 to P90.
